To open Gmail, you can sign in from a computer or add your account to the Gmail app on your phone or tablet.
Once you're signed in, open your inbox to check your mail.
On your computer, go to Gmail.
Enter your Google Account email or phone number and password.
*   If information is already filled in and you have to sign in to a different account, click **Use another account**.
*   If you get a page that describes Gmail instead of the sign-in page, at the top right of the page, click **Sign in**.
**Tip:** If you sign in to a public computer, make sure to sign out before you leave the computer.
Learn how to sign in on a device that's not yours.
If you forget your Gmail username or password, or you can’t access your account, follow our guide to troubleshoot your issue.
If you still can’t sign in, recover your Gmail account.
